verdict.rationale: Adyen provides the raw building blocks an agent could use — webhooks for status change events, refusal-reason codes for failed payments, idempotent retry requests, and an MCP server exposing webhook list/get/test tools — but there is no documented native dunning/retry-orchestration feature (e.g., automatic subscription retry schedules or built-in dunning email/outreach) comparable to a billing-specific product. missing for 10: dedicated subscription/dunning retry engine, evidence of an agent workflow specifically driving retries or outreach, and any dunning-outreach tooling (email/SMS sequencing).
